cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.27)
project(HicsPipeWireProbes LANGUAGES C)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 17)
find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
pkg_check_modules(PipeWire REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET libpipewire-0.3)
pkg_check_modules(DBus REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET dbus-1)
option(HICS_PROBE_ASAN "Instrument standalone diagnostics, never release runtime" ON)
foreach(probe portal-pipewire-frames pipewire-context-lifetime)
    foreach(control raw owned-dbus)
        set(target ${probe}-${control})
        add_executable(${target} ../${probe}.c)
        target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE PkgConfig::PipeWire)
        target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
        if(control STREQUAL "owned-dbus")
            target_compile_definitions(${target} PRIVATE HICS_TEST_RESIDENT_DBUS)
            target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE PkgConfig::DBus)
        endif()
        if(HICS_PROBE_ASAN)
            target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined -g -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
            target_link_options(${target} PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined)
        endif()
    endforeach()
endforeach()
